title: Compiled scope artifact (FK-P2)
description: Closed artifact document emitted by @foreman-line/spec-body-compiler. Unknown fields, unknown enum values and missing required data fail closed; artifactVersion mismatch refuses. Lists are sorted ascending by UTF-16 code-unit order of their canonical spelling. `surfaces:` never appears in any field (D10).

allowedFiles.description: Exact canonical repo-relative paths (Entry). May be empty; never globs; no scope syntax of any kind (grants are exact non-glob — D10).

frozenSurfaces.description: Negative authority (ScopeRef). Exact paths or the deny-only `path/**` directory-scope form. Sources: entries annotated `frozen` in the `**Forbidden surfaces (exact):**` paragraph (Step-0 flag C ruling).

forbiddenSurfaces.description: Negative authority (ScopeRef). Exact paths or the deny-only `path/**` directory-scope form. Sources: entries not annotated `frozen` in the `**Forbidden surfaces (exact):**` paragraph.

authorityState.description: `granted` iff allowedFiles.length > 0. Every consumer MUST refuse `empty` (MISSING_AUTHORITY) — the empty set is never widened.

compiledScopeDigest.description: sha256: + 64 lowercase hex over the F05.5 wrapper {domain: "foreman-line.spec-body-compiler.compiled-scope", apiVersion: "0.1.0", payload: <artifact without this member>}.
